I know this is an old question, but I'm having the same issue right now and didn't find a solution

Em segunda-feira, 4 de maio de 2020 às 23:40:48 UTC-3, rem...@gmail.com escreveu:
> Hello,
> Thank you for providing such a useful package. I am working on an LPA with 1400 participants and 34 indicators. When I attempt to run the analysis with model 6, and model 2 with 8 or more profiles, the code runs continuously for many hours until I eventually stop it. I am able to run models 1 and 3 without issue. I have experienced certain model parameterizations in the past that did not converge and provided an error message, but I have yet to see one under the current conditions. Since these are more complex models, I am wondering if this is related a computer processing issue on my end? Any insight would be appreciated.
> Thank you,
> Gary
